text:
Noah: quick Friday check-in from me — thanks for the sprint grind. Two quick themes: 1) stability & launch readiness, 2) tighten cost guardrails. High-level asks below.

Priya: noted. I'll own the launch readiness checklist and dependency signoffs. Deliverable: completed checklist + stakeholder ack by Tue 9am PT.

Marco: engineering update 1: the minor incident Wed (db connection storm) root cause was a retry loop in the prewarm path. SRE patch merged, rollout scheduled tonight. We'll add a circuit breaker in the prewarm client.

Elena: product will freeze non-critical UX changes Mon 00:00 PT to stabilize flows for partners. Any UX hotfixes after that need CTO approval.

Tariq: finance note 1: platform unit cost drift to watch 1: tokens per dollar worsened 6% vs last week due to high long-context runs. If we hit 10% we trigger rate-limited experiments.

Noah: for SLAs: propose two tracks — enterprise (SLA-backed p95 & uptime) and general (best-effort SLOs + cost-optimized routing). Priya please draft wording for customer comms.

Marco: rollout plan for tonight's patch:
```
- deploy svc-prewarm v2.1
- enable circuit-breaker = true
- monitor connection-failures, tail-latency
- if failures spike >0.5% rollback
```

deploy-bot: Starting rollout 1829013300, svc-prewarm v2.1 to 30%

deploy-bot: Rollout update: 20m in, connection-failures falling, p95 improved 12% :thumbsup:

Marco: will run a 90m soak tomorrow morning PST to validate. If soak passes we'll promote to 100%.

Priya: launch checklist highlights I'm tracking: security signoff (Elena), integration runbook (Marco), partner comms (me), support playbooks (Tariq).

Tariq: support playbook draft done, will add the escalation matrix and cost-related customer Q&A by Mon EOD.

Noah: policy change note 1: beginning next month we will require code owners to approve infra config changes that affect latency/cost. Small teams will have a 48h review SLA. Priya to announce externally.

Elena: for partner onboarding we want a one-page migration summary and a migration checklist. I'll draft and circulate by Wed.

Priya: comms plan 1: short note to partners + knowledge base article + webinar. Draft will be in #marketing by Wed noon.

Noah: two metrics I want tracked daily over next two weeks: 1) platform median p95 (global) 2) cost per 1M tokens (normalized). Auto-alert if p95 > baseline+15% or cost > baseline+8%.

finance-bot: baseline cost per 1M tokens = $48.2, current = $51.08 (6% up).

Noah: next steps: owners post any blockers here by Mon 6pm PT. We'll have a 20-min sync Tue 10:30 PT to lock the go/no-go for the partner launch. Thanks team. :rocket:
